definitions.gloss: mental arithmetic; mental calculation; calculating in one's head
definitions.explanation: Performing mathematical calculations without using a calculator, pen and paper, or abacus — purely in one's mind.

examples.japanese: {暗算|あんざん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}した→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
examples.english: I calculated it in my head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暗算|あんざん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧で、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}できる→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
examples.english: He's good at mental arithmetic and can quickly calculate large numbers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合計|ごうけい}→合計：02817_goukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{暗算|あんざん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|だ}そう→出す：01087_dasu⟧とした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧わからなくなった。
examples.english: I tried to work out the shopping total in my head, but lost track partway through.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{暗算|あんざん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb meaning "to calculate mentally."

ETYMOLOGY:
{暗|あん} (dark, hidden) + {算|ざん} (calculation). The idea is calculating "in the dark" — without visible aids.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗算|あんざん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧ (to calculate mentally)
- {暗算|あんざん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧ / ⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧ (good/bad at mental math)
- {暗算|あんざん}⟦{検定|けんてい}→検定：13131_kentei⟧ (mental arithmetic proficiency test)
